title: NodeHold
description: A node's external wait (docs/design/m0/02 "Hold reasons and resume signals"; plan 15 L4): approvals, quotas, human acts, probes. Internal inputs wait structurally and need no hold (13). A replacement node keeps a transferred hold's id, signal instance, owner and paging history, so escalation never restarts (13 supersession). Lease holds stay on the lease (05).

hold.description: A registered hold (schemas/vocab/holds.yaml); internal/graph checks that it is registered.

signal_instance.description: The concrete signal that resumes it, e.g. the reset time or the approval id awaited (02).

owner.description: Who owns the hold now: the registry's owner, or its escalate_to once page_after has passed.

owner_ref.description: The concrete owner, for the owner kinds that name one: the grant holder's actor id, the named owner, or the environment owner the profile names. Null for system, operator and confirmation_policy, which resolve without one.

since.description: When the wait began; page_after counts from here, also across a transfer.

pages.description: The paging history, oldest first and append-only. Pages are deduplicated by hold id and signal instance, never by channel (02).
